series: Promo bank, built Oct 7, 2026 for CMO review
hook: The reorder plan wants $2,793.90. Usable cash: $1,500
hook_say: Here is what happens when the reorder plan costs more than the cash you can spend, and how the planner splits the order.

rows.label: Cash available for stock
rows.why: The planner's sample shop has $1,800 it can put into stock.

rows.label: Bills due before stock lands
rows.why: $300 of bills fall due before the order arrives.

rows.label: Recommended order
rows.why: Reorder points, safety stock and 14 days between orders across 16 SKUs: the plan wants $2,793.90.

rows.label: Shortfall
rows.why: That is $1,293.90 more than the usable cash.

rows.label: Order now, most urgent first
rows.why: The Cash Check ranks every SKU by stockout risk and days of stock and funds the top of the list: $1,497.50 now.

fix.label: Deferred to the next order
fix.why: The rest, $1,296.40, moves to the next cycle, with $2.50 of cash left.

cta.title: Inventory Spreadsheet with Reorder Planner
cta.say: Search ProofNotFluff for the full workbook.

note: Example numbers from the planner. Yours go in the yellow cells.

sources_build: Built from the repo engine with python3 engines/cash-aware-reorder-planner/build_xlsx.py and recalculated in LibreOffice headless (tools/render_xlsx.py, 0 error values) on Oct 7, 2026. As-of date is the typed sample date 2026-09-28 (1 Your Shop D16), so these figures do not drift with the calendar.
